verdict.rationale: Keycloak is fully open source and self-hostable, with first-party Docker run instructions, container/Operator/Kubernetes install guides, and long-running community reports of production self-hosting for years. Minor caveat: some operational friction reported (resource usage, clustering complexity) but these are operational trade-offs, not evidence self-hosting doesn't work — missing for 10: independent benchmark of resource footprint or scaling at large scale beyond anecdotal reports.
